Class Pong

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
java.awt.Window
java.awt.Frame
javax.swing.JFrame
csta.ibm.pong.Game
pong.Pong
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible, RootPaneContainer, WindowConstants
public class Pong extends csta.ibm.pong.Game
The main game, runs the 2 minute Pong match and everything that happens in it Besides normal Pong there's powerup rolls, Zetamac math duels that fire volleys of balls, and the Buddha palm finale at the end
Author:
Youngwoo Nam, Brighton Ng

  • Method Summary

    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    void
    act()
    Runs every frame and basically controls the whole game Counts down the clock, moves the paddles, starts the timeline events, bounces the balls off paddles and walls, adds points and checks for a winner Precondition: setup() has already run Postcondition: everything is updated for this frame, scores are updated if someone scored, and the game stops if someone won or the clock ran out
    private void
    addPoint(int scorer)
    Gives a player a point, updates their label and plays the goal sound
    private void
    centerPaddle(Paddle p)
    Moves a paddle to the middle of the screen up and down
    private boolean
    checkWinner()
    Checks if anyone has won yet If a player has WINNING_SCORE points the game ends and shows who won Precondition: p1Score and p2Score are up to date Postcondition: if someone reached WINNING_SCORE the game is stopped and the winner is shown, otherwise nothing happens
    Ball
    createBall()
    Adds a new ball in the middle, unless there's already MAX_BALLS in play
    private void
    duelReward(int winner, int volleySize, boolean buddhaPalm)
    Flashes the tiger and fires the volley In the finale the loser fires instead, and the winner's Buddha palm blocks it once the balls get close (see palmStrike)
    void
    endGame()
    Stops the match and shows the end screen Higher score wins, if the scores are the same it's a tie Postcondition: the game and music are stopped and the Game Over popup is showing
    void
    finishPanel(int winner)
    Shows who won and asks if they want to play again Yes restarts the match, No closes the game

    Opens the game window the size of the whole screen and starts the match
    void
    launchVolley(int winner, int count)
    Fires a spread of balls from a player's paddle at the other player The balls are temporary so they disappear after they score
    static void
    main(String[] args)
    Starts the program by showing the start screen The game window is only made after Play is pressed, so the clock and music haven't started yet
    private void
    palmStrike(int winner)
    The finale's Buddha palm, freezes on "Oops got it wrong!", then flashes the Buddha and stretches the winner's paddle over the whole field for PALM_MS so it blocks the whole volley
    private void

    Freezes the game for a bit, then starts it again
    private void

    Puts a ball back in the middle at normal speed after someone scores
    private void
    resetGame()
    Puts everything back to how it was at the start of a match so you can play again Postcondition: scores are 0, paddles are normal and centred, the clock is full, there's one ball in the middle and the music is playing

    Both players roll a random powerup at the same time Whoever is behind gets theirs for longer to help them catch up
